tips.text: Rotate through all three bounties instead of grinding one for a missing part; each one's second zone drops only its own component, so one tileset looks like broken drop rates.
Run the Steel Path variant solo; objectives scale down and spawns stay maxed.
Prefer Critter Liberation when you can pick; it is the fastest of the three, three to six minutes solo on Steel Path.
On the bonus stage kill the 35 enemies before hacking the console, or the bonus mushroom is voided; you only need to stand in the zone, not kill inside it.
Buy the crafting mushrooms you lack from Nightcap at 10 Fergolyte each instead of hunting them.
Fully analyze the cheap mushrooms first to reach Rank 3 fast; Dull Button needs only 4 samples.
Use Orokin Eye air support to spot mushrooms through walls; Golden Instinct does not show them.
Build with whatever drops; duplicate blueprints cannot be composted or traded.
Players call this a pleasant farm when run right; the slog is Nightcap's Rank 4 and 5, not the blueprints.
Most finish in a few hours to a couple of days, but some reach 70 runs missing one part.
